# Matter Poise
Robotics & Intelligent Machines. Matter, poised to act.

## Company website
- [Company](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/about/): company purpose and team experience.
- [Products](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/products/): GROUNDWISE quadruped systems, WAYROUND spherical systems, FlatHill dexterous manipulation end-effectors.
- [Dual-arm platform](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/products/dual-arm/): coordinated manipulation and end-effector integration platform with model specifications.
- [ROSE](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/rose/): proprietary AI-assisted engineering system in development.
- [Engineering & Integration](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/engineering/): engineering, buildability, testing, serviceability and repeatability.

## Public technical references
- [Model catalog](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/products/#models): eleven model and platform snapshots.
- [Documentation](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/docs/): handbook, CSVs, integration guide and source register.
- [Structured product data](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/catalog.json): source values, design targets, pending values and conflicts remain distinct.
Detailed CAD, SDK, firmware, test evidence and manufacturing packages require a project-specific team handoff; no authenticated portal is offered here.

## Investment Relations
- [Agent Based Pitch Flow](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/investment-relations/): how investors can begin evidence-based research using their own AI assistant, then follow up with the team.
- [Investor presentation](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/): independently maintained business presentation.
- [Investor DD workspace](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/#workspace): source-linked editorial Q&A, topic selection and an exportable evidence-request list.
- [Public investor briefing](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/brief-v2.1.1.txt): versioned evidence register and evidence-led research guidance for the investor's own AI assistant.
- [Uploadable briefing](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/investor-dd-brief.md): self-contained fallback when the AI assistant cannot read links.
- [Public Data Room index](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/#dataroom): public documents and generic team-request categories; no private files or authenticated access.
- [Portable Skill](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/SKILL.md): optional instructions for hosts that support Skills; not a universal installation or live team connection.
The DD workspace is a public test version. Curated answers are not live model inference; the investor's AI cannot access the local management playbook. AI is auxiliary, and material company commitments require written team confirmation.
Company experience, development targets and future plans must not be treated as verified company traction, final specifications or current production capacity.
